meta.notes: Weights in pounds (as per Aventuria Armory English edition). Prices in Silbertaler. Structure Points (SP) indicate item durability. Focus rules bonuses noted where applicable.

equipment.name: Astrolabe
equipment.description: Complex instrument used by astrologists to determine calendar date, time of day, future position of constellations, and times of dawn and dusk. With SR 8 in Astronomy, grants +1 bonus to Astronomy checks. Allows calculating time to within 5 minutes.

equipment.name: Armillary Sphere
equipment.description: Spherical astrolabe variant showing orbits of stars and constellations. Easier to use than flat astrolabe, less precise. Successful Astronomy check increases SP by 1 (max 18). Requires SR 6 in Astronomy.

equipment.name: Backpack, Leather
equipment.description: Sturdy leather backpack ideal for carrying tools, provisions, and treasure. Can be worn over one or both shoulders. Carries up to 110 pounds of equipment.

equipment.name: Belt Pouch
equipment.description: Pouch that slides onto a belt with slits on the reverse side. Multiple compartments for trinkets, tools, vials, or small weapons. Retrieving an item from a belt pouch takes only 1 action.

equipment.name: Blacksmith's Hammer
equipment.description: Heavy hammer for forging hot steel. Can serve as improvised weapon. STR +1 on third partial Metalworking (Blacksmith) check.

equipment.name: Boltan Card Set (Cloth)
equipment.description: 72 elemental cards (Inrah deck) for the popular card game Boltan (Five Aces). Six elements (Fire, Water, Air, Ore, Humus, Ice) with seven numbered cards each plus five picture cards. Cloth version.

equipment.name: Boltan Card Set (Paper)
equipment.description: 72 elemental cards (Inrah deck) for Boltan. Paper version, more durable. Popular in Horasian Empire.

equipment.name: Breviary of the Twelvegods
equipment.description: Religious tome presenting the creed of the Twelvegods. Many editions exist. Contains descriptions of the twelve gods, demigods, prayers, and conduct guidelines. Grants +1 SGC bonus on second partial Religions check for general info on Alveran deities. Language: Garethi / Kuslik Signs.

equipment.name: Candles (10)
equipment.description: 10 standard candles (beeswax, tallow, or sperm whale oil). Burning time 10 hours each. Candlelight reduces darkness visibility modifiers within 12-foot radius: -4/-3/-2/-1 for 3/6/9/12 foot radii.

equipment.name: Candle Clock
equipment.description: Specially marked candle that allows determining time of day to within 30 minutes. Functions like a regular candle otherwise.

equipment.name: Magic Candle
equipment.description: Special candle with secret ingredients for rituals. For invocations/banishments: +1 bonus on first partial check when correct number used (demons: 7, elementals: 6, ghosts: 5). Functions like a regular candle otherwise.

equipment.name: Cartographer's Tools
equipment.description: Ruler, divider, colored inks, and other tools for making accurate maps. DEX +1 on Artistic Ability (Drawing) checks when drawing maps.

equipment.name: Chalk
equipment.description: One piece sufficient for 20 pictures or large drawings like pentagrams. Used by scholars, miners, adventurers, and thieves for marking paths.

equipment.name: Magic Chalk
equipment.description: For drawing ritual circles and magical symbols. After drawing necessary symbols (demons: 7 drawings, elementals: 6, ghosts: 5), +1 bonus on first partial check to invoke or abjure the respective being.

equipment.name: Climbing Hooks (10)
equipment.description: Steel hook attachments for climbing walls and rock faces. When combined with climbing rope, grant +1 bonus on Climbing checks.

equipment.name: Climbing Rope (per yard)
equipment.description: Hemp climbing rope typically 65+ feet long, strong enough for multiple adult humans. When combined with climbing hooks, grants +1 bonus on Climbing checks.

equipment.name: Silk Rope (per yard)
equipment.description: Thinner, lighter, and more expensive than hemp rope but equally durable. Preferred by burglars and scholars. When combined with climbing hooks, grants +1 bonus on Climbing checks.

equipment.name: Cloak
equipment.description: Knee-length cloak protecting from rain and cold. Can function as blanket or improvised bag. Fighters sometimes wrap around arm for parrying. Intuition +1 bonus for Stealth (Conceal Item) if item can be hidden underneath.

equipment.name: Codex Albyricus
equipment.description: Body of law governing guild mages' rights and responsibilities. Seven volumes. Successful Law (Guild Law) check increases SP by 1/2/3 when possessing 1/3/7 usable volumes. Language: Bosparano / Kuslik Signs.

equipment.name: Coin Bag
equipment.description: Circular leather piece with lace through holes. Holds up to 50 coins. DEX -1 penalty on Pick Pocket (Steal from Person) checks against target with coin bag.

equipment.name: Coin Pouch
equipment.description: Sophisticated coin container with multiple pockets for different coin types. Holds up to 20 coins. DEX and AGI both -1 on Pick Pocket checks against target with coin pouch.

equipment.name: Compass (South-Pointer)
equipment.description: Needle containing meteoritic iron that always points south. +1 bonus to Orientation checks. Allows calculating cardinal directions. Dwarves and Achaz have long valued this tool.

equipment.name: Copper Cauldron
equipment.description: Cooking cauldron of copper. Can serve as improvised weapon. STR +1 on second partial Cooking check.

equipment.name: Crowbar
equipment.description: Heavy iron pry bar for forcing open doors, crates, and locks. STR +1 on first partial Feat of Strength (Prying Open) check. Can serve as improvised weapon.

equipment.name: Encyclopaedia Magica
equipment.description: Reference work for magical knowledge. SGC +1 on Magical Lore checks. Language depends on edition.

equipment.name: Dice Set
equipment.description: Set of six-sided dice for various games. INT +1 on Gambling (Dice Games) checks.

equipment.name: Dressing Material (Bandages and Splints)
equipment.description: Basic bandages and splints for treating wounds. DEX +1 on first partial Treat Wounds check.

equipment.name: Flask
equipment.description: Container for liquids, holds about one quart. Can carry water, ale, or other beverages.

equipment.name: Flint and Steel
equipment.description: Fire-starting tools. DEX +1 on Craft (Firemaking) checks when using quality flint and steel.

equipment.name: Figurine of God or Goddess
equipment.description: Small devotional figure of a deity. Provides comfort and may grant minor bonuses to religious practices. Cost varies widely by deity, material, and quality.

equipment.name: Grapnel
equipment.description: Multi-pronged hook for throwing onto ledges, walls, or ship railings. When used as improvised chain weapon: see weapon tables. DEX +1 on Climbing checks when using grapnel with rope.

equipment.name: Gwen-Petryl Stone
equipment.description: Rare mineral that emits a faint light (turquoise or yellow-red glow). Found in temples of Efferd. Provides dim light within small radius. Cannot be extinguished.

equipment.name: Hand-axe or Hatchet
equipment.description: Utility axe for chopping wood. Can serve as improvised weapon: +1 DP vs plants (+2 vs wooden objects), but -2 DP vs armor PRO 3+. STR +1 on Woodcutting checks.

equipment.name: Helpful Primer for the Traveling Adept
equipment.german_name: Hilfreicher Ratgeber für den wandernden Adepten
equipment.description: Practical handbook for traveling mages. Covers survival, navigation, social customs, and more. SGC +1 on relevant knowledge checks. Language: Garethi / Kuslik Signs.

equipment.name: Herbarium Kuslikum
equipment.description: Comprehensive reference for plant identification. +1 SP on successful Plant Lore checks. Language: Garethi / Kuslik Signs.

equipment.name: Hookah
equipment.description: Water pipe for smoking. Common in Tulamydian culture. Social item for negotiations and hospitality. CHA +1 on Seduce or Carousing checks in appropriate cultural contexts.

equipment.name: Hourglass
equipment.description: Sand-filled glass for measuring time intervals. Allows timing up to one hour. Useful for ritual timing and navigation.

equipment.name: Lantern
equipment.description: Oil-burning lantern. Burns 5 hours per dose of oil. Provides light in 30-foot radius. Wind-protected, unlike torches. Reduces darkness visibility modifiers: -4/-3/-2/-1 for 8/16/24/30 foot radii.

equipment.name: Lockpick
equipment.description: Tool for picking locks. DEX +1 on Pick Locks checks. For bit locks: grants bonus to one DEX partial check for Pick Locks (Bit Locks).

equipment.name: Mage Robe
equipment.description: Official garb of guild mages. Grants +1 bonus to Arcane Lore checks when worn in appropriate social contexts. Required by Codex Albyricus for guild mages during formal occasions.

equipment.name: Oil Lamp
equipment.description: Small oil-burning lamp. Burns 10 hours per dose of oil. Provides light in 15-foot radius. More fuel-efficient than lantern but smaller radius.

equipment.name: Padlock
equipment.description: Portable lock for securing containers, doors, and chains. Lock quality varies from poor to excellent, affecting Pick Locks difficulty.

equipment.name: Paper and Parchment
equipment.description: Writing material. One sheet of parchment (1 S) or paper. Essential for scholars, scribes, and mages recording magical formulas.

equipment.name: Perfume
equipment.description: Scented oil or liquid. CHA +1 on Seduce checks when wearing appropriate perfume. Quality varies widely from cheap to very expensive.

equipment.name: Phial
equipment.description: Small glass vial for holding potions, poisons, or alchemical substances. Typical container for healing potions and magical preparations.

equipment.name: Pocket Watch (Vinsalt Egg)
equipment.description: Mechanical clockwork timepiece known as a 'Vinsalt Egg'. Allows determining time to within 5 minutes. Luxury item for wealthy merchants and nobles.

equipment.name: Provisions (1 day)
equipment.description: One day's worth of food and drink (bread, dried meat, cheese, water). Costs 3 S per day in standard quality. Rations in wilderness cost double if purchased from merchants.

equipment.name: Quadrant
equipment.description: Navigational instrument for determining latitude and measuring angles to celestial bodies. +1 bonus to Navigation checks at sea. Requires clear sky.

equipment.name: Roast Skewer
equipment.description: Long iron skewer for roasting meat over fire. Can serve as improvised weapon: 1d6 DP from tip, cloth and leather armor -2 PRO vs skewer attacks. On successful parry: must make Feat of Strength or drop skewer.

equipment.name: Rolling Pin
equipment.description: Kitchen tool for rolling dough. Can serve as improvised weapon. Stunning Blow maneuver inflicts 1d3+1 DP. Breaks on confirmed botch.

equipment.name: Rope, Binding
equipment.description: Thin rope suitable for binding limbs, securing loads, and general utility. STR +1 on Feat of Strength (Dragging & Pulling) checks for tying.

equipment.name: Rope Ladder
equipment.description: Rope ladder with wooden rungs, typically 10 feet long. DEX +1 on Climbing checks when using rope ladder.

equipment.name: Shoulder Bag
equipment.description: Leather bag worn over shoulder. Holds up to 30 pounds. Quick access to stored items.

equipment.name: Sleeping Bag
equipment.description: Insulated sleeping bag providing protection against cold during rest. Reduces cold level by 1 while sleeping. Prevents certain penalties from poor sleep conditions.

equipment.name: Sickle
equipment.description: Curved blade for harvesting grain or cutting herbs. Can serve as improvised weapon (see weapons table). Useful tool for herbalists and farmers.

equipment.name: Snowshoes
equipment.description: Woven frame worn on feet to walk on snow. Reduces movement penalties in deep snow. Body Control (Balance) check +1 bonus when running in snow.

equipment.name: Soap
equipment.description: Soap for hygiene. Also useful for lubricating mechanisms. Can serve as improvised chain weapon in cloth tube (see weapon tables).

equipment.name: Spade
equipment.description: Digging tool. STR +1 on Earthwork checks. Can serve as improvised two-handed weapon.

equipment.name: Pickaxe
equipment.description: Mining and digging tool. STR +1 on Mining checks. Can serve as improvised two-handed weapon. Subtracts 1 PRO from armor PRO 4+ when used as weapon.

equipment.name: Telescope
equipment.description: Optical instrument for viewing distant objects. Reduces visibility modifiers for distant observation by 2. INT +1 on Perception (Observing) checks.

equipment.name: Tent (Small, 1-2 persons)
equipment.description: Small tent for 1-2 persons. Protects from rain and wind. Reduces cold level by 1 when sleeping inside in mild conditions.

equipment.name: Tent (Large, 4-6 persons)
equipment.description: Large tent for 4-6 persons. Full weather protection.

equipment.name: Tinderbox
equipment.description: Box containing flint, steel, and tinder for starting fires. Reliable fire-starting. DEX +1 on Craft (Firemaking) checks.

equipment.name: Torch
equipment.description: Oil-soaked wooden torch. Burns 1 hour. Provides light in 20-foot radius. Can serve as improvised weapon. Reduces darkness visibility modifiers: -4/-3/-2/-1 for 5/10/15/20 foot radii.

equipment.name: Underwear
equipment.description: Standard underclothing: shirt, trousers, stockings. Basic protection against cold.

equipment.name: Vademecum of Combative Crafts
equipment.description: Comprehensive guide to various combat techniques and weapons. Grants +1 SP on successful Combat Techniques checks for specific weapons covered in the book.

equipment.name: Waterskin
equipment.description: Leather container for water. Holds about 2 quarts. Essential for travel. Prevents dehydration penalties.

equipment.name: Woolen Blanket
equipment.description: Warm woolen blanket. Reduces cold level by 1 when sleeping. Can serve as improvised cloak or rain protection.

equipment.name: Oil (Flask)
equipment.description: Flask of lamp oil. Fuels one lantern or oil lamp for 5-10 hours. Can be used as incendiary in extremis.

equipment.name: Writing Set (Quill, Ink, Paper)
equipment.description: Quill pen, inkwell, and several sheets of paper for writing. Essential for scholars and mages recording spells or research.

equipment.name: Healing Herbs
equipment.description: Bundle of medicinal herbs for basic wound treatment. DEX +1 on Treat Wounds checks when using quality herbs. One bundle sufficient for 3-5 treatments.

equipment.name: Mirror
equipment.description: Small polished metal or glass mirror. Useful for signaling, checking around corners, and defeating some supernatural creatures.

equipment.name: Lockpick Set
equipment.description: Complete set of lockpicks for various lock types. DEX +2 on Pick Locks checks. Illegal to carry without justification in most Aventurian cities.

equipment.name: Pack Mule (reference)
equipment.description: Pack animal for carrying equipment. Can carry up to 200 pounds. Standard transport animal for adventurers. Requires feed and care.

equipment.name: Riding Horse (reference)
equipment.description: Standard riding horse. Can be ridden at walking pace (60 feet/round) or gallop (240 feet/round). Requires stabling, feed, and care.
